entry.title: New: Resolution 462 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR MULTI-YEAR LEASES FOR TWO MULTI-FUNCTION COPY MACHINES FOR THE OFFICE OF MANAGEMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into four-year lease agreements with an approximate monthly cost of $600 for both copiers, to be used by the department’s Hilo and Kona offices.
